description: Ingest a file (PDF, .md, or .txt) into a project: archives the original into sources/raw/<date>/, extracts text locally (pdfjs for PDFs — no API call), writes an .extracted.md sidecar for PDFs, and returns the text. Accepts a local absolute path OR an http(s) URL that points directly at a file (e.g. an arXiv PDF link) — URLs are downloaded first. After calling this, discuss the key takeaways with the user and file a summary via mindbase_contribute.

path.description: Absolute path on disk, or a direct http(s) URL to a PDF/.md/.txt file

projectId.description: Project id; defaults to the current project (config.json)

title.description: Optional human title; defaults to the filename

name: mindbase_ingest_file
